_comment: Cross-area research threads. POSITION BASE for future papers: attach each new paper to exactly one thread first, then choose 1-3 parents from that thread’s members (ordered oldest to newest). Adding a paper = append member + edges; do not reorder members.
_placement_protocol: Match the paper to a thread by its position_guide trigger; if none fits, create a new thread rather than forcing it.
Pick 1-3 parents from the thread members that the paper directly extends, evaluates, or repairs; record relation builds_on with a one-sentence rationale.
Write the area page entries (Timeline chronological, Paper List batch, Recent Activity line) and the lineage edges in the paper’s primary area file; add cross_area bridges for parents in other areas.
Add the paper as a node in _meta/graphify_seed/graph.json with the thread’s community number and a hyperedge update.

threads.label: Time Series + LLM Reasoning
threads.description: The arc from zero-shot TS forecasting with frozen LLMs, through the diagnosis that forecasting does not imply reasoning, to aligned TS-LLM models, RL-incentivized reasoning, verifiable thinking data, and clinical benchmarks.
threads.position_guide: Attach a paper here if it trains or evaluates an LLM that reads time series, synthesizes TS reasoning traces, or benchmarks TS reasoning. Parents: the closest method it modifies (ChatTS/TS-Reasoner for alignment, TimeOmni-1/VeriTime for RL and data, Merrill/SenTSR/TSRBench for evals).

threads.label: Latent / Continuous Reasoning
threads.description: Reasoning moved off language tokens: superposition theory for continuous chain-of-thought, then latent visual reasoning in Monet. Related Zotero items already in reasoning.md: Coconut, CODI, Chain of Superposition (Deng), Latent Space Survey.
threads.position_guide: Attach a paper here if it reasons in a continuous latent space instead of discrete tokens. Parents: the CoT baseline it replaces and the nearest latent-reasoning method.

threads.label: Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness
threads.description: Do CoT traces reflect actual reasoning? Unfaithful explanations, faithfulness measurement, per-step necessity and accuracy probes, and hallucination snowballing through generation.
threads.position_guide: Attach a paper here if it analyzes, measures, or repairs the fidelity of reasoning traces. Parents: CoT plus the specific faithfulness claim it tests.

threads.label: Multimodal Chain-of-Thought
threads.description: Chain-of-thought generalized to interleaved modalities: interleaved-modal CoT, grounded CoT, internalized visual thinking; plus the visual-token efficiency line (1/2 tokens after layer 2, one-token LLaVA-Mini).
threads.position_guide: Attach a paper here if it reasons across image and text or compresses visual tokens for reasoning. Parents: the CoT variant it extends and the VLM efficiency method it builds on.

threads.label: Time Series Foundation Models
threads.description: Decoder-only forecasting foundation models and wearable-sensing foundation models; TS-Reasoner aligns them with LLM reasoning.
threads.position_guide: Attach a paper here if it pretraining a general time-series or wearable-sensing backbone. Parents: the backbone architecture and the FM it scales or specializes.

threads.label: Vision SSL and Regularization Classics
threads.description: Regularization lineage (Dropout to Cutout) and the masked-autoencoder self-supervised vision anchor; MIRAGE evaluates whether VLMs truly understand images.
threads.position_guide: Attach a paper here if it is a regularization method, a masked self-supervised vision method, or a probe of visual understanding.

threads.label: LLM Efficiency and Analysis Foundations
threads.description: Transformer analysis beyond attention (residual and normalization layers) and the attention-sink fix for streaming inference.
threads.position_guide: Attach a paper here if it analyzes transformer internals or fixes an inference-time failure mode. Parents: the transformer component it studies.
